cards.name: Achilles, Doomed to Glory
cards.rules: First strike. Whenever Achilles attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, Achilles gets +2/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.

cards.name: Ajax, Unyielding Rival
cards.rules: Ward {2}. Whenever one or more cards leave a graveyard or an Equipment enters under your control, if this is the first time this ability triggered this turn, tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.

cards.name: Odysseus, King in Thesprotia
cards.rules: Trample. When Odysseus enters, create two 1/1 red and green Warrior creature tokens. Whenever Odysseus attacks, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.

cards.name: Telegonus, Bearer of the Stingray Spear
cards.rules: Deathtouch. When Telegonus enters, tap up to one target creature an opponent controls. Whenever a legendary creature dealt damage by Telegonus this turn dies, draw a card and you lose 1 life.

cards.name: Ares, Rout of the Thesprotians
cards.rules: Menace. When Ares enters, creatures your opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn. Whenever one or more creatures you control die, Ares deals 2 damage to each opponent. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Athena, Opponent of Ares
cards.rules: Vigilance, ward {2}. When Athena enters, tap up to two target creatures. Whenever one or more creatures attack you, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.

cards.name: Priam, King of Troy
cards.rules: Whenever one or more lore counters are put on a Saga you control, scry 1. At the beginning of your end step, if you cast a historic spell this turn, draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Hector, Defender of Troy
cards.rules: Vigilance. Other attacking legendary creatures you control get +1/+0. Whenever one or more legendary creatures you control attack, untap up to one target creature you control.

cards.name: Cassandra, Before the Fall
cards.rules: At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 2. The first spell you cast from exile each turn costs {1} less to cast. Whenever you cast a spell from exile, each opponent mills a card.

cards.name: Apollo, Separator of Gods
cards.rules: Vigilance. When Apollo enters, exile all attacking creatures until end of combat, then return those cards to the battlefield tapped under their owners’ control.

cards.name: Callidice, Last Queen
cards.rules: First strike. Whenever Callidice attacks, another target attacking creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If that creature is legendary, it also gains indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Polypoetes, Inheritor of Thesprotia
cards.rules: Deathtouch. Whenever one or more permanent cards leave your graveyard, you may return a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. This ability triggers only once each turn. Whenever a land you control enters from a graveyard, create a 1/1 black and green Citizen creature token.

cards.name: Hephaestus, Forger of Heroes
cards.rules: Artifacts you control have ward {1}. Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may tap or untap target artifact. This ability triggers only once each turn. Whenever an artifact becomes untapped during your turn, scry 1.

cards.name: Apollo, Defender of Troy
cards.rules: Reach, vigilance. Whenever you scry, Apollo deals 1 damage to each opponent. Whenever another legendary creature you control attacks, scry 1.

cards.name: Artemis, Huntress at Aulis
cards.rules: Reach, vigilance. When Artemis enters, put a stun counter on each Vehicle. Vehicles with stun counters on them can't attack. Whenever another creature dies, its controller may remove a stun counter from a permanent they control.

cards.name: Odysseus, Home Once More
cards.rules: At the beginning of combat on your turn, untap another target creature you control. It gains haste until end of turn. If it entered from exile this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

cards.name: Poliporthes, Son of Penelope
cards.rules: Vigilance. Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Poliporthes is tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on up to two other target creatures you control. Those creatures gain vigilance until your next turn.

cards.name: Autolycus, Master of Cunning
cards.rules: Ward {1}. Whenever Autolycus deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of that player’s library. Until end of turn, you may play that card. You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.

cards.name: Telegonus Searches for His Father
cards.rules: Scry 3, then manifest fate twice. Put a +1/+1 counter on each face-down creature you control. Until your next turn, those creatures have ward {2}.

cards.name: Telegonus Ravages Ithaca
cards.rules: Telegonus Ravages Ithaca deals 4 damage divided as you choose among up to two target creatures and/or Vehicles. Draw a card if a legendary permanent was dealt damage this way.

cards.name: Wrest the Road from Proteus
cards.rules: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle. Exile the top two cards of your library. You may play one of them until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: The Islands of the Blest
cards.rules: The Islands of the Blest enters tapped unless you control a legendary permanent. {T}: Add {C}. {2}, {T}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast legendary spells.

cards.name: Aphrodite, Patron of Paris
cards.rules: Indestructible. As long as your devotion to red and white is less than seven, Aphrodite isn't a creature. Whenever an enchantment you control enters, gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap it. It gains haste until end of turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Ares, War-Loving God
cards.rules: Indestructible. As long as your devotion to black and red is less than seven, Ares isn't a creature. Whenever one or more creatures attack, if a creature you controlled died this turn, Ares deals 2 damage to each opponent and you draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
